test_docstring_options: test pybind11 docstring options to verify disable_function_signatures and disable_user_defined_docstrings behavior
test_overloaded_docstrings: test pybind11 overloaded function docstrings to verify docstring handling on first and second overload definitions
test_function_signature_generation: test pybind11 function signature generation to verify enable_function_signatures produces correct type-annotated signatures
test_nested_docstring_options: test pybind11 nested docstring options to verify RAII scope and enable_user_defined_docstrings within disabled context
test_docstring_suppression: test pybind11 docstring suppression to verify non-function objects like classes and properties have no docstrings
